verdict.rationale: Independent hands-on reports describe working embedded signing integrations. One team built a POC in Postman in about an hour and shipped a production service (comm-4). Another uses the REST API to create embedded envelope signing URLs without issues (comm-5). This is backed by the official eSignature REST API and Node client for sending and signing (docs-21, docs-40), and web forms can also be embedded in business apps (docs-43). One team hit a session-breakout problem on page refresh that was fixed only by moving to a legacy API version (comm-1), a real but isolated caveat. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the embedded signing / recipient-view flow in the pack, assurance that the session-breakout issue is resolved on current API versions, and documentation of iframe or UI customization options for the embedded signer.
